```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set Environment and load packages
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

rm(list=ls())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, width = 2500)

if("pacman" %in% installed.packages() == FALSE) {install.packages("pacman")}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse,
               magrittr,
               ggcorrplot,
               ggpubr,
               ggeffects,
               Hmisc,
               car,
               psych,
               lme4,
               lsmeans,
               sjPlot,
               ggdark,
               effectsize)

# Set your own working director here
setwd()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in and set up data
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

# Each row represents a unique participant x audience combination
load("./Study 2 cleaned adn recoded data (dis con).rda")

# Filter out participants who met the criteria outlined in the pre-registration
cleaned_long %<>% filter(problem == 0, PID != "for time")
```

# Main manuscript analyses
```{r descriptives}
# Audience splits collapsed across group size (binary)
cleaned_long %>%
  group_by(audience, yesno) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(counts = n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = yesno, values_from = counts) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(audience != "Partner") %>%
  mutate(percent_yes = round(yes / (yes + no) * 100, 2))
```

```{r mixed effects model}
# Logit with binary concealment outcome as a function of audience (within) and condition (between) controlling for random effect of participant. We excluded "romantic partner" from these analyses.
binary_conceal_glmer <- glmer(yesno ~ audience * condition + (1 | PID),
                              data = filter(cleaned_long, audience != "Partner"),
                              family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

car::Anova(binary_conceal_glmer, type = "III")

# effect sizes

# audience only
binary_conceal_audience <- glmer(yesno ~ audience + (1 | PID),
                              data = filter(cleaned_long, audience != "Partner"),
                              family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

r.squaredGLMM(binary_conceal_audience)

# audience and group size
binary_conceal_audiencecondition <- glmer(yesno ~ audience + condition + (1 | PID),
                              data = filter(cleaned_long, audience != "Partner"),
                              family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

r.squaredGLMM(binary_conceal_audiencecondition) - r.squaredGLMM(binary_conceal_audience)

# full model
r.squaredGLMM(binary_conceal_glmer) - r.squaredGLMM(binary_conceal_audiencecondition)

# test audience effects collapsed across group size
emmeans(binary_conceal_glmer, list(pairwise ~ audience), adjust = "tukey")
```

# Supplemental analyses

```{r frequency model}
# frequency is the outcome, condition (between) and audience (within) main effects and interactions, participant is the random effect
frequency_conceal_lmer <- lmer(frequency ~ condition * audience + (1 | PID), REML = T,
                               data = filter(cleaned_long, audience != "Partner"))

# omnibus test of ANOVA
frequency_conceal_anova <- Anova(frequency_conceal_lmer, type = "III", test.statistic = "F")

frequency_conceal_anova

cohens_f(frequency_conceal_anova, alternative = "two.sided")

# test marginal effects
emmeans(frequency_conceal_lmer, list(pairwise ~ audience), adjust = "tukey")

emm <- emmeans(frequency_conceal_lmer, c("condition", "audience"), adjust = "tukey")

# Pairwise comparisons between group size for each audience
emmeans(frequency_conceal_lmer, pairwise ~ condition | audience, adjust = "tukey")

# Effect size (in d, convert to f for supplement by dividing by 2)
eff_size(emm, sigma = sigma(frequency_conceal_lmer), edf = Inf)
```

```{r figure}
# Manuscript figure
# Percentage 
percent_plot <- cleaned_long %>%
  group_by(condition, audience, yesno) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(counts = n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = yesno, values_from = counts) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(audience != "Partner") %>%
  mutate(percent_yes = round(yes / (yes + no) * 100, 2)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = audience, y = percent_yes/100, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", alpha = .5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#88CCEE", "#332288"), labels = c("One-on-one", "Group of 10")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Family", "Flirt", "Friend", "Co-worker", "Stranger")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Percentage of participants who reported concealing", fill = "Ever concealed",
       x = "Audience",
       y = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black" , size = 12, hjust = .5))

# Frequency
frequency_plot <- cleaned_long %>%
  filter(audience != "Partner") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = audience, y = frequency/100, fill = condition)) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", alpha = .5, position = position_dodge(width = .9)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = .1, color = "black",
               position = position_dodge(width = .9)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#88CCEE", "#332288"), labels = c("One-on-one", "Group of 10")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Family", "Flirt", "Friend", "Co-worker", "Stranger")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Concealment frequency", y = "", x = "Audience") +
   theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black" , size = 12, hjust = .5))

# Combine plots
ggarrange(percent_plot, frequency_plot, ncol = 2, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom")
```
